Raiders vs Browns DraftKings Showdown Picks: Sunday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Sunday Night Football, November 29 · NFL Week 12 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 27, 5:36 PM ET

Deshaun Watson has the highest SPAGS projection in the Raiders at Browns DraftKings Showdown: 18.4 points at $10,400 FLEX, 27.7 at captain for $15,600. In a game totaled at 39.5, the model's favorite play is the quarterback who also runs. It has him carrying 6.4 times, and across 50,000 simulations he holds 78% of the winning-lineup credit.

He also has the largest captain share: 19.2% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Watson at captain. Ashton Jeanty is the next captain in line, at 14.4%. The model gives him 11.0 carries and 5.6 targets.

Cleveland is a 4.5-point favorite, and the implied totals are 22 for the Browns and 17.5 for the Raiders.

Behind Watson and Jeanty, the next projections are Fernando Mendoza (14.5, $10,000), Brock Bowers (13.1, $9,800) and Harold Fannin Jr. (12.5, $8,400).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 27, 5:36 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 50,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

Chris Spags' latest NFL DFS breakdown on the Splash Play NFL channel.

SNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Deshaun Watson, CLE QB ($10,400 FLEX / $15,600 CPT)

Deshaun Watson holds 19.2% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $15,600 and the 18.4-point SPAGS model projection becomes 27.7 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 6.4 rushing attempts. Across 50,000 simulations Watson averaged 18.5 points with a simulated floor of 11.6 and a ceiling of 34.9. He holds 78% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 19.2% as the captain and 59.0% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Ashton Jeanty, LV RB ($9,000 FLEX / $13,500 CPT)

Ashton Jeanty holds 14.4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $13,500 and the 13.8-point SPAGS model projection becomes 20.7 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 11.0 carries and 5.6 targets. Across 50,000 simulations Jeanty averaged 13.8 points with a simulated floor of 2.8 and a ceiling of 31.7. He holds 48% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 14.4% as the captain and 34.1% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Harold Fannin Jr., CLE TE ($8,400 FLEX / $12,600 CPT)

Harold Fannin Jr. holds 13.2% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $12,600 and the 12.5-point SPAGS model projection becomes 18.7 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 6.0 targets on 29.4 routes. Across 50,000 simulations Fannin averaged 12.5 points with a simulated floor of 1.9 and a ceiling of 31.2. He holds 40% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 13.2% as the captain and 26.8% in a FLEX spot.

Top FLEX projections for Raiders vs Browns

Fernando Mendoza, LV QB ($10,000 FLEX / $15,000 CPT)

Fernando Mendoza carries the 2nd-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 14.5 DraftKings points for a $10,000 FLEX salary ($15,000 at captain). The model includes 3.3 rushing attempts. Across 50,000 simulations Mendoza averaged 14.5 points with a simulated floor of 8.7 and a ceiling of 27.5. He holds 51% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 6.7% as the captain and 44.7% in a FLEX spot.

Brock Bowers, LV TE ($9,800 FLEX / $14,700 CPT)

Brock Bowers carries the 4th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 13.1 DraftKings points for a $9,800 FLEX salary ($14,700 at captain). The model gives him 7.2 targets on 28.9 routes. Across 50,000 simulations Bowers averaged 13.2 points with a simulated floor of 2.1 and a ceiling of 32.4. He holds 40% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 13.1% as the captain and 27.4% in a FLEX spot.

Quinshon Judkins, CLE RB ($8,600 FLEX / $12,900 CPT)

Quinshon Judkins carries the 6th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 11.7 DraftKings points for an $8,600 FLEX salary ($12,900 at captain). The model gives him 13.4 carries and 2.3 targets. Across 50,000 simulations Judkins averaged 11.7 points with a simulated floor of 4.5 and a ceiling of 19.6. He holds 41% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 4.2% as the captain and 36.3% in a FLEX spot.

KC Concepcion Jr., CLE WR ($8,000 FLEX / $12,000 CPT)

KC Concepcion Jr. carries the 7th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 11.6 DraftKings points for an $8,000 FLEX salary ($12,000 at captain). The model gives him 5.5 targets on 27.1 routes. Across 50,000 simulations Concepcion averaged 11.6 points with a simulated floor of 4.4 and a ceiling of 22.4. He holds 39% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 5.8% as the captain and 33.4% in a FLEX spot.

Raiders projects for 6.1 DraftKings points at a $3,400 FLEX salary, 1.79 projected points per $1,000. Across 50,000 simulations Raiders averaged 6.1 points with a simulated floor of -1.8 and a ceiling of 15.9. It holds 24% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 1.8% as the captain and 22.4% in a FLEX spot.

Value: Browns, CLE DST ($4,400 FLEX / $6,600 CPT)

Browns projects for 7.4 DraftKings points at a $4,400 FLEX salary, 1.68 projected points per $1,000. Across 50,000 simulations Browns averaged 7.5 points with a simulated floor of -2.3 and a ceiling of 16.3. It holds 33% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 2.2% as the captain and 30.6% in a FLEX spot.

Raiders vs Browns DraftKings Showdown FAQ

Who is the best captain for the Raiders vs Browns DraftKings Showdown?

Deshaun Watson holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 19.2%, ahead of Ashton Jeanty (14.4%) and Harold Fannin Jr. (13.2%), across 50,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Raiders vs Browns?

Build around Harold Fannin Jr. at captain with Deshaun Watson, Ashton Jeanty and Quinshon Judkins at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (104 of 50,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $9,400 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Raiders vs Browns DraftKings Showdown?

Deshaun Watson leads the SPAGS model at 18.4 DraftKings points for $10,400 at FLEX, or 27.7 points at captain for $15,600.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Raiders vs Browns Showdown?

Deshaun Watson is the most expensive player at $10,400 FLEX and $15,600 at captain. All 29 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

What are the best value plays in Raiders vs Browns DraftKings Showdown?

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Raiders (6.1 points at $3,400), Browns (7.4 points at $4,400) and Andre Szmyt (8.1 points at $5,000).

What is the Raiders vs Browns spread and total?

The Browns are a 4.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 39.5, with implied team totals of 22 for the Browns and 17.5 for the Raiders.
